description.en: Animated neon skins and a free wallpaper shelf for the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 界面加上动态霓虹皮肤、呼吸边框和免费壁纸库。

description.en: Ten code-drawn animated skins, a breathing neon window frame, a glowing composer ring, and a wallpaper shelf (Wallhaven / Bing / Picsum / Mixkit live clips / Sakugabooru anime highlights) with playlists and a local cache.
description.zh: 十款纯代码动态皮肤、呼吸霓虹边框、输入框光环，外加壁纸库（Wallhaven / Bing / Picsum / Mixkit 动态素材 / Sakugabooru 番剧高光），支持播放列表与本机缓存。
